newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin says five bids for insurance unit.
newsitem.headline: Serfin says five bids for insurance unit.

text.p: Five insurance companies are seeking to buy a 49-percent stake in the Serfin financial group's insurance arm, Seguros Serfin, a Serfin executive said on Monday.

"For a year we have been in the process (of selling off Seguros Serfin). We have several interested parties, such as five companies that have tabled proposals," said a Serfin executive, who spoke on condition he not be named.
The executive said Serfin was selling the stake in its insurance subsidiary, which he valued at less than $200 million, in order to raise capital for the group.
